input.evidence: IR night footage. The box is flagged '?' (identity uncertain) and contains two cows lying side by side: a black cow behind and a white-faced cow in front, both sternal. Neither moves at -20, 0 or +20 s. Their heads are not touching and there is no butting, licking or mounting, so I saw no social interaction. A standing cow at the right edge of the box is mostly outside it; she walks up and lies down by +20 s. She is probably what triggered the tracker's 'standing' (P=0.99) and 'social' votes. Chew check: 1.26 Hz but peak-to-median only 1.9 (below 4), so this is not good evidence of rumination.
input.self_check: Checked three time points across the minute and ran a chew check. Biggest risk: identity. The box overlaps several cows, so if Cow06 is really the cow at the right edge, she stood, sniffed the lying pair and then lay down. That would make her 'standing', or briefly 'social_interaction'. At night I can't judge ears, nose or flank, so clinical signs are not assessable.
